edits.before: 摘要：针对骨干网小时级源—目的（OD）流量序列兼具高频突发波动与长周期演化趋势、传统多尺度模型参数冗且静态融合易受噪声干扰的问题，提出一种自适应多尺度加权的多变量网络流量预测方法。该方法通过非重叠时间聚合构造多分辨率输入，利用三个参数独立的分解线性专家（DLinear）解耦并提取各尺度下的趋势项与余项特征，进而设计仅含131个参数的轻量级窗口路由网络，提取历史窗口的四维时域统计特征，自适应生成样本级多尺度融合权重。在Abilene和GÉANT真实骨干网数据集上的重复实验表明：在24 h预测任务中，所提方法仅以LightTS模型6.41%和2.17%的参数规模（仅8339个参数），实现了25.77%和43.74%的均方误差（MSE）降幅，相较于单尺度DLinear及静态多尺度融合策略，MSE最高降低4.97%，且在高需求峰点的平均低估误差降低达16.07%。在GÉANT数据集168 h长周期预测任务中，其MSE和平均绝对误差（MAE）较DLinear分别显著降低23.16%和11.16%，展现出优异的精度—复杂度平衡性与工程预测稳健性，可为骨干网容量规划与资源调度提供可靠支撑。

edits.before: Abstract: An adaptive multiscale weighting method is proposed for multivariate network traffic forecasting to address the coexistence of high-frequency burst fluctuations and long-term evolution in hourly origin-destination (OD) traffic series of backbone networks, as well as parameter redundancy and noise-sensitive static fusion in conventional multiscale models. Non-overlapping temporal aggregation constructs multiresolution inputs, and three independently parameterized decomposition linear models (DLinear) extract trend and residual components at each scale. A lightweight window router with only 131 parameters then extracts four time-domain statistics from each historical window to generate sample-specific multiscale fusion weights. Repeated experiments on the Abilene and GÉANT backbone-network datasets show that, for 24-hour forecasting, the proposed method achieves mean relative reductions in mean squared error (MSE) of 25.77% and 43.74%, respectively, using only 8,339 parameters, equivalent to 6.41% and 2.17% of the respective LightTS parameter counts. Compared with single-scale DLinear and static multiscale fusion strategies, the maximum MSE reduction reaches 4.97%. In addition, the average underestimation error at high-demand peak points on Abilene decreases by 16.07% relative to DLinear. For 168-hour forecasting on GÉANT, MSE and mean absolute error (MAE) decrease substantially by 23.16% and 11.16%, respectively, relative to DLinear. These results demonstrate a favorable accuracy-complexity balance and robust forecasting performance for engineering applications, providing reliable support for backbone-network capacity planning and resource scheduling.
